AI took center stage during China's Singles Day shopping gala this year.

- E-commerce giant JD.com reported sales of over 50 million AI-powered products, , with sales of AI-equipped computers, workstations, cameras and smart glasses more than doubling yoy.

effective_posts.original_text:
AI took center stage during China's Singles Day shopping gala this year.

- E-commerce giant https://t.co/mlOADua5P6 reported sales of over 50 million AI-powered products, , with sales of AI-equipped computers, workstations, cameras and smart glasses more than doubling yoy.

- One of China's best-known livestreamers, Li Jiaqi, on Nov. 2 sold about 100,000 monthly subscriptions for Alibaba's QwenWork AI office service in just 30 minutes, equivalent to around 2 trillion tokens.

- On Tmall, sales of AI tokens surged more than 700% between Oct. 15 - Nov. 5 compared with the period from Sept. 15 - Oct. 5. (Screenshot)
effective_posts.translation_zh:
今年中国的“双11”购物盛会上，AI 成为焦点。

- 电商巨头 JD.com 报告称，AI 驱动产品销量超过5000万件，其中配备 AI 的电脑、工作站、相机和智能眼镜销量同比增长超过一倍。

- 11月2日，中国最知名的直播主播之一李佳琦在短短30分钟内售出了约10万份 Alibaba 的 QwenWork AI 办公服务月度订阅，相当于约2万亿个 token。

- 在 Tmall 上，10月15日至11月5日期间，AI token 的销售额较9月15日至10月5日期间飙升超过700%。（截图）
